summary: The new norm-support method and exercised ordinary cases are sound at the checked scales, but one exact original-set false acceptance and two certificate/degenerate-set defects block the proposed numerical qualification.

findings.title: Fixed precision certifies a point outside the original closed physical ball
findings.exact_oracle: With e_d=0 the direct set is the singleton d_obs. Fraction.from_float squared arithmetic gives ||d_obs||^2-Dmax^2=Fraction.from_float(1e-60)^2 > 0. The feasible intersection is empty.
findings.observed: compatible=true, physical_set_empty=false, NORM_BOUNDS_CERTIFIED; witness (.125,1e-60,0), reported physical_norm=.125.
findings.cause: 100-decimal-digit square/sum/sqrt rounds away the positive 1e-120 contribution; no outward interval or exact comparison protects ball membership or emptiness. The response cancellation allowance cannot enlarge the dipole domain.
findings.minimum_repair: Use exact binary64 rational/integer squared comparisons for both balls and ball-intersection geometry; uncertainty must never become a feasible witness.

findings.title: Float serialization invalidates certified residual and score enclosures
findings.exact_oracle: The minima are sqrt(2) and sqrt(3). Fraction(returned_lower)^2 > 2 in the first case; Fraction(returned_upper)^2 < 3 and Fraction(score)^2 < 3/4 in the second.
findings.observed: Both interval endpoints equal nearest float sqrt(2)=1.4142135623730951 or sqrt(3)=1.7320508075688772; score for sqrt(3) is 0.8660254037844386 with score_kind CERTIFIED_UPPER_BOUND.
findings.cause: The internal 1e-75 scale enclosure disappears under round-to-nearest conversion; upper/lower and subsequent division are not rounded outward.
findings.minimum_repair: Round exported lower down and upper up against the internal enclosures, and conservatively round the upper-score division. Preserve explicit typed range handling.

findings.title: A representable tangent singleton is lost by the shrunken-anchor construction
findings.exact_oracle: The two closed balls are externally tangent at d=(.125,0,0), exactly representable and within both original balls; its residual is less than .001.
findings.cause: The radial anchor is multiplied by (1-16 eps), moving the tangent point outside the direct ball. There is no explicit tangent singleton branch.
findings.minimum_repair: Detect tangency exactly and construct/verify its unique witness. Distinguish a real nonempty tangent set with an unrepresentable float witness from an empty set. Also retain exact zero-radius/zero-response membership paths.

mathematical_audit.assumptions: Fixed real STF S, seven signed Frobenius-orthonormal STF3 coordinates, magnitude O and kappa=5/ln(10); dimensionless direct d=-A/(cH) in one declared congruence. Moving-observer beta=v/c is a distinct target. Supplied radii remain declared bounds; empirical CF4 error law is absent.
mathematical_audit.support_lemma: For ||u||<=1, ||O-Kd|| >= u.O-(K^T u).d. Over C=ball(center,e_d) intersect ball(0,R), h_C(v) <= min(v.center+e_d||v||, R||v||); subtracting that upper support gives a valid lower residual bound. No multiplier, KKT floor or solver success is needed. This is a valid alternative to the supplied norm-subgradient lemma.
mathematical_audit.global_allowance: cap=min(||center||+e_d,R) bounds ||d|| over the intersection, and ||Kd||<=||K||F cap. The use of max(||O||,||K||F cap) covers the cancellation scale globally in the rejection test, rather than only at the current iterate.
mathematical_audit.remaining_enclosure_defects: Exact set predicates lack enclosures (NCF1); float output conversion lacks directed rounding (NCF2). High precision alone is not exact membership or a public certified interval.
mathematical_audit.rank: For nonzero STF S, M=(S:S)I/3+2S^2/5 is positive definite even when S is rank deficient. The checked rank-2 S gives rank-3 L; S=0 remains a separate sector.
mathematical_audit.source_and_covariance: Full source covariance and all d/O cross blocks are retained under the supplied synthetic map. Source-level finite-z control is O(z) in magnitude. They do not infer a real optical input law or coverage.

primary_source_verification.assessment: Corrected distance/chart and leading spurious slope octupole are consistent with the cited primary source; this does not validate empirical CF4 attribution.
